meta.title: Update benchmark with PyPy and Cython
meta.body_summary: Add PyPy and Cython benchmarks to the mochi benchmark harness; re-run benchmarks and update BENCHMARK.md with results; also compute globals at runtime in TypeScript compiler.

perf_labels.notes: Codex added PyPy/Cython benchmarks and TS runtime global computation; merged within 14 seconds with no review or collaboration.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 674 changed lines across 22 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, though most churn is in benchmark output files and BENCHMARK.md. It fits a straightforward benchmark infrastructure extension that was merged rapidly without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comments; merged by author immediately.
review_details.performance_claim: Update benchmark harness to include PyPy and Cython, and recompute TS globals for correctness.

core_change_summary.description: In bench/runner.go, added logic to detect PyPy and Cython, generate and run benchmarks for those languages, and updated BENCHMARK.md and bench/out/*.ts.out files with new results. Also changed compile/ts/compiler.go to compute globals at runtime instead of static, affecting many TS output files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Multiple .ts.out benchmark output files were updated with new results from the benchmark rerun.
change_trajectory: Single commit added PyPy and Cython to runner, generated new benchmarks, updated TS compiler to compute globals at runtime, and refreshed all benchmark output files.
